To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the best summarization algorithm for Twitter posts is the one that selects the top three posts in the set and that the most effective way to summarize a set of tweets is to select the top three tweets in that set.

(1) our algorithm that selects posts based on their similarity to the query is the most effective, (2) our algorithm that ranks posts by their similarity to the topic is the least effective, (3) the best performing algorithm is not necessarily the best performing algorithm on all queries, and (4) our best performing algorithm is better than the best traditional summarization algorithm on 50% of the queries.
the best performing algorithm is the one that uses a simple heuristic to select posts and that the best performing heuristic uses the number of hashtags in a tweet.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following question: How well do the summaries generated by these algorithms reflect the manually produced summaries?
the question: how can we best summarize Twitter posts?
the question: How can we summarize a set of posts on a micro log service such as Twitter?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are no significant differences between the algorithms.
there is no clear winner among the systems we evaluated.
the best performing algorithm is a simple one, which selects the top posts based on a single criterion.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the best summarization system for Twitter posts is a system that uses both traditional summarization algorithms as well as Twitter-specific algorithms.
the two algorithms we present perform better on Twitter than traditional systems, although there is still room for improvement.
, in the case of Twitter, the traditional summarization algorithms are not as effective as one might expect.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the best summarization algorithms for micro log posts are those that use micro log specific features, like hashtags, to produce their summaries.
the summarization algorithms we present can generate summaries that are competitive with traditional summarization systems and that are more accurate than manually produced summaries.

, while traditional summarization algorithms do a reasonable job on micro log data, they are not able to capture the essence of the data as well as a simple algorithm that is specifically tuned for the micro log domain.
